post.title: Lambda Architecture Pattern: Balancing Batch Accuracy with Streaming Freshness
post.subtitle: Combine speed and batch layers when both low latency and deterministic recompute are mandatory.
post.brief: Lambda architecture is justified when replay correctness and sub-minute freshness are both non-negotiable despite dual-path complexity.

content.markdown:
## Scenario context

Lambda architecture is justified when replay correctness and sub-minute freshness are both non-negotiable despite dual-path complexity.

> **TLDR**: Lambda architecture is a fit only when you need both low-latency views and deterministic recompute from trusted history.

Twitter's 2015 trend detection system serves as the canonical warning: their Storm speed layer and Hadoop batch layer both looked healthy, but were…

This walkthrough focuses on **Lessons Learned**.

Before making a design choice, clarify:

- - Lambda is a business-driven architecture choice, not a default modern stack.
- - Shared transformation semantics are the core reliability investment.
- - Replay time and drift rate are as important as latency.

**Concepts in play:** api-gateway, event-driven-architecture, spark-data-engineering, jvm-internals-and-garbage-collection

## End-to-end outcome

After working through the stages, you should be able to explain:

- - Lambda is a business-driven architecture choice, not a default modern stack.
- - Shared transformation semantics are the core reliability investment.

## Alternatives considered

The source focuses on one primary design. A second architecture is not compared, so no alternative is invented here.

## Failure and degraded modes

The source does not isolate a separate failure mode. Limits that matter for the scenario are called out in the stage decisions above.
